author: Inside Edition
description: A chopper reporting on a dramatic SWAT team operation zoomed a camera in to find a deputy scrolling through a dating app. Deputies deployed a so-called "grappler" to bring a stolen car to a standstill. Instead, the vehicle veered off to the side and crashed into a wall. The deputy scrolling through a dating app was just feet away from the high-stakes negotiations with the suspect in the car. The Riverside County Sheriff's Office says they have initiated an internal investigation.
title: Chopper Catches SWAT Deputy Scrolling Dating App During Operation

author: Inside Edition
description: A Doordasher dropped off food at the Oval Office and President Donald Trump himself answered. Sharon Simmons was invited to celebrate the first anniversary of the No Tax On Tips policy. But, after delivering the food, the president invited Simmons to stick around. She suddenly found herself thrust into the international spotlight as the president was peppered with questions about the Pope and the war with Iran. Simmons' appearance was a promotional event set up by DoorDash and the White House.
title: DoorDasher Delivering Food To President Trump Faces World's Press

author: Inside Edition
description: Democratic Congressman Eric Swalwell suspended his campaign in California’s governor race amid multiple sexual misconduct allegations Sunday. While denying the allegations, he took to social media to make his announcement. “I am suspending my campaign for Governor,” Swalwell posted. “To my family, staff, friends, and supporters, I am deeply sorry for mistakes in judgment I’ve made in my past. I will fight the serious, false allegations that have been made — but that’s my fight, not a campaign’s.”
title: Eric Swalwell Ends Race for California Governor Following Sexual Misconduct Allegations

author: Inside Edition
description: Pop star Britney Spears has voluntarily checked into a rehab treatment facility. This comes five weeks after the singer made headlines for an alleged DUI in Ventura, California. In a statement about the arrest, her reps said, "This was an unfortunate incident that is completely inexcusable. Britney is going to take the right steps, and comply with the law and hopefully this can be the first step in long-overdue change that needs to occur in Britney’s life." Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Singer Britney Spears Has Voluntarily Checked Into A Rehab Facility

author: Inside Edition
description: It's a war of words between two world leaders. President Donald Trump attacked the leader of the Catholic Church on social media in a Sunday night post, but Pope Leo insists he is only preaching the Gospel. Pope Leo has begun an historic 10-day trip to visit four African nations. However, questions from the media aboard his flight to Algeria focused on President Trump's Truth Social post about the Pope. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Pope Leo Says Trump Doesn't Understand The Gospel's Message About Peace

author: Inside Edition
description: Jennifer Linares from Virginia is battling a rare autoimmune disease that has left her allergic to the sun.
title: Woman Allergic To Sun Because Of Rare Autoimmune Disease #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A man in Illinois had to be pulled from the water after falling in the Des Plaines River in the early hours of the morning. An officer with the Joliet Police Department heard the man's cries around 4 a.m. The officer called in some help, and a group from the Joliet P.D. deployed ropes and water rescue equipment. Their efforts were captured on officer bodycam. The officers tried to pull the man up the bank, but he was too weak.
title: Man Who Fell Into River Was Too Weak To Be Pulled Up Bank
